answer: Every trading key locks basalt in the haven escrow, and the lock grows with how many keys one operator already holds. Haven joins keys whose deposits or payouts ever touch a common wallet, so an operator's k-th joined key must lock 25k basalt. Forge audits sampled results and burns the basalt of every joined key if any one of them fakes an answer. A lone key locks 25 basalt, but a 100-key farm locks 126,250, all lost together. To stay unjoined, the operator must fund each clone through its own verified exchange account.
